slides.title: Nutrient Preservation
slides.subtitle: The impact of proper cooking techniques
bullets: Light steaming preserves water-soluble vitamins far better than heavy boiling.
Rapid sautéing in stable oils locks in vital micronutrients without degradation.
Proper temperature control prevents the breakdown of essential dietary antioxidants.

slides.title: Pillars of Wholesome Kitchens
slides.subtitle: Core strategies for daily meal preparation
slides.imagePrompt: Close-up of chef hands meticulously chopping vibrant organic bell peppers and leafy greens on a rustic wooden cutting board with soft kitchen lighting

cards.title: Whole Ingredients
cards.description: Prioritizing unprocessed foods ensures your body receives complex carbohydrates, clean fibers, and untouched micronutrients directly from nature without hidden chemical additives.

cards.title: Mindful Seasoning
cards.description: Replacing excess sodium with fresh herbs, citrus zests, and aromatic spices elevates natural flavors while protecting cardiovascular health and maintaining balanced blood pressure.

cards.title: Healthy Fats
cards.description: Utilizing cold-pressed olive oil, avocado extracts, and omega-3 rich seeds supports optimal brain function and enhances the bioavailability of fat-soluble vitamins.

slides.title: Cooking Method Face-Off
slides.subtitle: Understanding the difference in daily preparation

leftSide.title: Traditional Boiling
bullets: Leaches essential water-soluble vitamins B and C directly into the cooking water.
Often results in muted colors, altered textures, and a significant loss of natural taste.
Requires heavy post-cooking seasoning to recover lost flavor profiles.

rightSide.title: Modern Steaming & Roasting
bullets: Encloses natural juices and locks in maximum nutritional value with minimal loss.
Caramelizes natural sugars to create rich, deep flavors without added heavy fats.
Maintains vibrant visual presentation and crisp, satisfying textures.

slides.title: The Meal Preparation Workflow
slides.subtitle: A step-by-step approach to efficient cooking
slides.imagePrompt: Overhead view of a clean modern kitchen counter with neatly arranged bowls of colourful vegetables, grains, and herbs ready for cooking, photographic realism

steps.title: 1. Inventory
steps.subtitle: Assess pantry
steps.description: Review existing fresh produce and pantry staples to plan balanced, nutrient-dense meals.

steps.title: 2. Prep
steps.subtitle: Mise en place
steps.description: Wash, chop, and organize all ingredients before turning on the heat for seamless execution.

steps.title: 3. Cook
steps.subtitle: Gentle heat
steps.description: Apply low-to-medium heat cooking methods that preserve delicate flavors and nutrients.

steps.title: 4. Plate
steps.subtitle: Mindful portioning
steps.description: Assemble colorful, balanced plates focusing on vegetable-forward portions and lean proteins.

slides.title: The Ultimate Objective
slides.statement: Let food be thy medicine and medicine be thy food.
slides.support: Healthy cooking is an act of self-respect that nourishes both body and mind.
